api.body:
if self.helper == nil then
	require "pixcHelper"
	self.helper = createPixcHelper(pixc,self())
end
if self.json == nil then self.json = require "json" end
local filePath = self.helper:getProperty("CSV File Path")
local warmupOffset = tonumber(self.helper:getProperty("Projector Warmup Minutes")) or 0
if filePath == nil or filePath == "" then
	pixc.error(self()..": CSV File Path is empty. Please set the path in the 'CSV Import' section.")
	return
end
filePath = filePath:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
local function splitCSVLine(line)
	local result = {}
	local field = ""; local inQuote = false
	for i = 1, #line do
		local c = line:sub(i, i)
		if c == '"' then inQuote = not inQuote
		elseif c == "," and not inQuote then table.insert(result, field); field = ""
		else field = field .. c end
	end
	table.insert(result, field)
	return result
end
local file = io.open(filePath, "r")
if not file then
	pixc.error(self()..": Cannot open CSV file: '"..filePath.."'. NOTE: Path must be ASCII only - no umlauts (ae/oe/ue), spaces or brackets. Move file to e.g. C:\\Pixera\\Showtimings.csv.")
	return
end
local content = file:read("*a"); file:close()
local lines = {}
for line in content:gmatch("[^\n\r]+") do table.insert(lines, line) end
if #lines < 3 then
	pixc.error(self()..": CSV file has fewer than 3 rows. Expected: row 1 = header, row 2 = time slots, row 3+ = show data.")
	return
end
-- Parse time slots from row 2 (columns 4+)
local headerCells = splitCSVLine(lines[2])
local timeSlotMap = {}       -- colIdx -> {h, m}
local sortedCols = {}        -- sorted list of colIdx with valid time slots
for i = 4, #headerCells do
	local hh, mm = headerCells[i]:match("(%d%d?):(%d%d)")
	if hh then
		timeSlotMap[i] = {h=tonumber(hh), m=tonumber(mm)}
		table.insert(sortedCols, i)
	end
end
table.sort(sortedCols)
if #sortedCols == 0 then
	pixc.error(self()..": No valid time slots found in row 2 of the CSV. Expected format HH:MM (e.g. 09:00).")
	return
end
-- Pre-scan: collect all DayRun numbers used in the CSV
local dayRunsInCSV = {}
for rowIdx = 3, #lines do
	local cells = splitCSVLine(lines[rowIdx])
	if #cells >= 3 then
		local drNum = cells[3]:match("(%d+)%s*$")
		if drNum then dayRunsInCSV[tonumber(drNum)] = true end
	end
end
-- Rebuild DayRuns namespace (merge CSV DayRuns with existing ones)
local dayRunActions = {}
if self.DayRuns ~= nil then
	for n, fn in pairs(self.DayRuns) do
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local existingNum = tonumber(tostring(n):match("^DayRun_(%d+)$"))
			if existingNum ~= nil and not dayRunsInCSV[existingNum] then
				table.insert(dayRunActions, {
					kind="func", name=n, slotStyle="leftIn;rightOut",
					body="pixc.report(\""..n.."\"); pixc.callRefs(\""..n.."\")\n"
						.."self.enqueueTimelineCheck("..existingNum..")",
					params={}
				})
			end
		end
	end
end
for num, _ in pairs(dayRunsInCSV) do
	local n = "DayRun_"..num
	local isNew = true
	if self.DayRuns ~= nil then
		local ok, result = pcall(function() return self.DayRuns[n] end)
		if ok and result ~= nil then isNew = false end
	end
	if isNew then
		pixc.warning(self()..": Action '"..n.."' is new – created automatically in DayRuns namespace. Please connect DayRuns."..n.." to the matching timeline in the Control graph.")
	end
	table.insert(dayRunActions, {
		kind="func", name=n, slotStyle="leftIn;rightOut",
		body="pixc.report(\""..n.."\"); pixc.callRefs(\""..n.."\")\n"
			.."self.enqueueTimelineCheck("..num..")",
		params={}
	})
end
if #dayRunActions > 0 then
	self().dynamicRebuildFromDescriptions(self.json.encode(dayRunActions), "DayRuns", "(.*)")
end
-- Build all Events: 3 events per day
--   Warmup_DDMMYY_DRx  : TEST column time - warmupOffset min  -> PowerAll
--   Day_DDMMYY_DRx     : TEST column time                     -> DayRun_X()
--   Shutdown_DDMMYY_DRx: one slot AFTER last non-empty col    -> PowerOff()
local module = {}
local eventCount = 0
local skippedRows = 0
local noShowDays = {}
local seenKeys = {}
local duplicateCount = 0
for rowIdx = 3, #lines do
	local cells = splitCSVLine(lines[rowIdx])
	if #cells >= 3 then
		local dd, mm, yyyy = cells[2]:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)")
		local dayRunNum = cells[3]:match("(%d+)%s*$")
		if dd then
			dd = tonumber(dd)
			mm = tonumber(mm)
			yyyy = tonumber(yyyy)
			if not self.isValidDateParts(dd, mm, yyyy) then
				table.insert(noShowDays, cells[2].." (invalid date - no events created)")
				skippedRows = skippedRows + 1
			else
				local numCount = 0
				if cells[3] then
					for _ in cells[3]:gmatch("%d+") do numCount = numCount + 1 end
				end
				if not dayRunNum then
					local dateStr = cells[2]
					local drInfo = (cells[3] ~= nil and cells[3]:match("%S")) and cells[3] or "no DayRun"
					table.insert(noShowDays, dateStr.." ("..drInfo.." - rest day)")
					skippedRows = skippedRows + 1
				elseif numCount > 1 then
					pixc.error(self()..": MULTI-DAYRUN - "..cells[2].." contains multiple DayRuns: '"
						..cells[3].."'. No events created for this day. Please add them manually.")
					table.insert(noShowDays, cells[2].." (MULTI-DAYRUN: '"..cells[3].."' - add manually!)")
					skippedRows = skippedRows + 1
				else
					local yyyyStr = tostring(yyyy)
					local yearSuffix = yyyyStr:sub(-2)
					local datePrefix = string.format("%02d%02d%s", dd, mm, yearSuffix)
					-- Duplicate check
					local dupKey = datePrefix.."_DR"..dayRunNum
					if seenKeys[dupKey] then
						duplicateCount = duplicateCount + 1
						pixc.warning(self()..": DUPLICATE - "..cells[2].." DayRun "..dayRunNum
							.." found in rows "..seenKeys[dupKey].." and "..rowIdx..".")
					end
					seenKeys[dupKey] = rowIdx
					-- ── Find show start: first cell matching 'test' (case-insensitive) ──
					local showCol = nil
					for _, colIdx in ipairs(sortedCols) do
						local val = cells[colIdx]
						if val ~= nil and val:lower():match("test") then
							showCol = colIdx
							break
						end
					end
					-- ── Find shutdown: one slot before the last non-empty cell ──
					local lastCol = nil
					for i = #cells, 3, -1 do
						if cells[i] ~= nil and cells[i]:match("%S") and timeSlotMap[i] then
							lastCol = i
							break
						end
					end
					local shutdownCol = nil
					if lastCol ~= nil then
						-- Shutdown = one slot AFTER the last occupied col (to the right)
						for si = 1, #sortedCols do
							if sortedCols[si] == lastCol then
								if si < #sortedCols then shutdownCol = sortedCols[si + 1] end
								break
							end
						end
					end
					-- ── Create events ──
					if showCol == nil then
						table.insert(noShowDays, cells[2].." (no TEST cell found - no events created)")
						skippedRows = skippedRows + 1
					elseif shutdownCol == nil then
						table.insert(noShowDays, cells[2].." (cannot determine shutdown time - no events created)")
						skippedRows = skippedRows + 1
					else
						local showData = timeSlotMap[showCol]
						local shutData = timeSlotMap[shutdownCol]
						if self.isValidTimeParts(showData.h, showData.m, 0)
							and self.isValidTimeParts(shutData.h, shutData.m, 0) then
							local showEpoch = os.time({year=yyyy, month=mm, day=dd,
								hour=showData.h, min=showData.m, sec=0})
							local shutEpoch = os.time({year=yyyy, month=mm, day=dd,
								hour=shutData.h, min=shutData.m, sec=0})
							if showEpoch ~= nil and shutEpoch ~= nil then
								local warmupEpoch   = showEpoch - (warmupOffset * 60)

local res = os.date(self.timeFormatCode)
if self.lastRes ~= res then self.lastRes = res; pixc.report(res) end
-- Find next upcoming event across all events in self.Events
local now = os.time()
local minDiff = 999999999
local nextName = "-"
local foundNext = false
if self.Events ~= nil then
	for eName, eFunc in pairs(self.Events) do
		if type(eFunc) == "function" then
			local stored = self["_"..eName]
			if stored ~= nil and stored ~= "" then
				local timePart = stored:match("^([^;]+)")
				if timePart then
					local y, mo, d, h, m, s = timePart:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+) (%d+):(%d+):(%d+)")
					if y then
						local ep = os.time({
							year=tonumber(y), month=tonumber(mo), day=tonumber(d),
							hour=tonumber(h), min=tonumber(m), sec=tonumber(s)
						})
						local diff = ep - now
						if diff > 0 and diff < minDiff then
							minDiff = diff
							nextName = eName
							foundNext = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
-- Format countdown as HH:MM:SS
local countdown = "-"
if foundNext then
	local h = math.floor(minDiff / 3600)
	local m = math.floor((minDiff % 3600) / 60)
	local s = minDiff % 60
	countdown = string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
end
-- Push to outputs (only update name when it changes, countdown updates every second)
if self._lastNextName ~= nextName then
	self._lastNextName = nextName
	self.NextEventName(nextName)
end
self.NextEventCountdown(countdown)
if self._upcomingDirty == true or now >= (self._nextUpcomingRefresh or 0) then
	self.updateUpcomingEvents()
	self._upcomingDirty = false
	self._nextUpcomingRefresh = now + 10
end
-- 5-minute post-event missed check: fire once per event, exactly 5+ min after scheduled time
local today2 = os.date("%Y.%m.%d")
if self.Events ~= nil then
	for eName, eFunc in pairs(self.Events) do
		if type(eFunc) == "function"
			and self["_fired_"..eName] == nil
			and self["_reported_"..eName] == nil then
			local stored = self["_"..eName]
			if stored ~= nil and stored ~= "" then
				local timePart = stored:match("^([^;]+)")
				if timePart then
					local storedDate = timePart:match("^(%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
					local y2, mo2, d2, h2, m2, s2 = timePart:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+) (%d+):(%d+):(%d+)")
					if y2 and storedDate == today2 then
						local ep2 = os.time({year=tonumber(y2), month=tonumber(mo2), day=tonumber(d2),
							hour=tonumber(h2), min=tonumber(m2), sec=tonumber(s2)})
						if (now - ep2) >= 300 then
							self["_reported_"..eName] = true
							pixc.warning(self()..": MISSED EVENT – '"..eName
								.."' was scheduled at "..timePart
								.." and has not fired 5 minutes after its scheduled time.")
							self.OnMissedEvent(eName)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local hour = tonumber(os.date("%H"))
local minute = tonumber(os.date("%M"))
local second = tonumber(os.date("%S"))
if hour == 4 and minute == 0 and second == 0 and self._last4amInit ~= os.date("%Y.%m.%d") then
	self._last4amInit = os.date("%Y.%m.%d")

end

		else

		end
	end

end

properties.cont: Automates daily show operations through scheduled events. CSV import creates 3 events per day: Warmup (PowerAll), DayRun (show start), Shutdown (PowerOff). Show start is detected by "Test" keyword in CSV. Shutdown is one time slot before the last occupied column. Features schedule watchdog, 4AM daily recovery, and missed-event reporting.

properties.cont: Creates Warmup_DDMMYY_DRx, Day_DDMMYY_DRx and Shutdown_DDMMYY_DRx events. DayRun_x will be created in DayRuns namespace if missing. Shutdown Time is optional – leave empty to skip shutdown event.
